settings.text:

We’ve been perfecting the process since 1991 to create world-class wooden pads for our satisfied customers. Our premium wood pads typically have a life span of up to 10 years with proper usage.

settings.title: simple and effective tiles
settings.text: Attractive event flooring that is easy to install.

In four simple and fast steps, you can have your surface fully installed in minutes or less.

Getting Started

The panels have two sides with female PowerLocks, and two sides with male PowerLocks. All tiles on any given installation should always have the female PowerLocks going in the same direction.

Step One

Begin the installation by laying down your first panel in any one corner and pointing the female PowerLocks in the two directions that additional panels are to be added.

Step Two

Place the next panel so that the male PowerLock line up over the top of the female loops on the first panel. It's important to make sure that the female PowerLocks are facing exactly the same direction as the first panel.

Step Three

Gently step along the joint of the two panels. You will hear and feel the PowerLocks snap into place as you go.

Step Four

Once the two panels are joined, repeat steps one through three remembering to keep the female PowerLocks aligned until your floor is complete. That's all there is to this easy-to-install flooring!

settings.subheading: CONTAIN THEM WITH THE FLOOR DEFENDER

settings.text: The underside of Floor Defender Pro Garage Containment Mats features a tatami grain pattern for increased traction. This patterned backing prevents these mats from lifting and allows them to retain their shape over extended periods of time. Also, the tatami grain patterned backing produces a smoother, less wrinkled surface than the smooth backed regular Floor Defender Garage Containment Mats.

settings.subtitle: GARAGE CONTAINMENT MATS
settings.title: CONTAIN THE ELEMENTS
settings.text: Rated for environment ranging between -40 degrees to +40 degrees Celsius. These mats are perfect for harsh winters.

settings.subtitle: OUTRIGGER SYSTEMS
settings.title: SAFETY SENSE
settings.text:
50% of crane failure or total collapse is from improper use of outriggers. A pro-active safety approach is using outrigger pads on all set ups. The outrigger pads will displace & reduce the PSI the ground “sees” from the point of contact of the outrigger/shoe/ float/pontoon on the equipment.

The outrigger pads will also remind the personnel at the jobsite to make sure the outrigger system is being used & used correctly.

settings.subtitle: GARAGE FLOOR PROTECTION MATS
settings.title: PROTECT AGAINST CHEMICALS
settings.text: Keep oil, geese, anti-freeze, and other chemicals that may drain out of your car contained, and away from other possessions stored in the garage.

settings.subtitle: Improved
settings.title: EASY CLEAN UP
settings.text: Floor defenders are very easy to clean, simply drag the mat outside with all its contents and hose it down. In a matter of minutes, the mat is ready to be redeployed and used all over again.
